scope_statement: Added deterministic feedback reconciliation from passing idiom product feedback summaries into privacy-safe workflow-state and evidence-link output without dispatching lanes, mutating .idiom runtime state, writing evidence exports, or promoting ranker learning.

commands: idiom tool context_pack --input {"task":"prd adr brief workflow atom 30 feedback reconciliation closeout","mode":"plan","limit":8}
go run ./cmd/idiom product feedback --effort-root <temp effort> --reconcile-summary references/feedback_summary.json --reconciled-state-output references/reconciled_workflow_state.json --json
JSON/JSONL validation for durable workflow artifacts
privacy secret-pattern scan over durable effort artifacts

discovery_evidence: context_query:execution feedback reconciliation workflow state durable evidence links next actions product workflow
privacy_note: report stores only scope, model assignment, command names, commit hashes, bounded findings, and blocker state; it does not store raw prompts, raw transcripts, file bodies, secrets, generated briefs, or customer-identifying data
